title: Add filter for orphaned issues (not in any epic)
description:
Add filter flag to find issues that could be part of an epic but aren't:

Usage:
  pebbles list --orphaned

Shows issues where:
- Issue type can_be_part_of_epic() returns true
- No part_of relationship exists
- At least one epic exists in the project

Benefits:
- Find issues that should be organized
- Clean up project structure
- Ensure all work is tracked in epics

Could combine with --issue-type to find specific orphans:
  pebbles list --orphaned --issue-type bug
